svg.text: Code controls the flow · AI agents advise · people approve anything with consequences
every request · IntakeCoordinator (workflow.py) runs the steps in a fixed order

g.text: gas · fire · flood: straight to a person, no AI
escalate: priority ≥ 4 in HVAC · electrical · plumbing (or a manager) → event in the outbox → incident worker

svg.text: escalated incidents only · Magentic orchestration (Microsoft Agent Framework)

g.text: plans · picks the next specialist · re-plans
task ledger + progress ledger · larger model

svg.text: Budgets per run: ≤ 10 rounds · ≤ 250k tokens · ≤ 5 tool calls per specialist · ≤ 240 s · read-only tools · redacted text only · small models for specialists

g.text: flags: safety block · high cost · unverified
Every step above is recorded: decision trail · model input and output · append-only audit · traces
a facility manager can open “Why this decision” for any request
